title: The contrast gate measures the Frequency Stage and Commons token pairs
detail:
check-contrast reads only app/globals.css, so the Frequency tokens have no gate (root cause of the 2026-10-22 contrast finding). Add Stage and Commons pairs from core.css and frequency.css, with waivers listed.

Contrast gate reads core.css and frequency.css across Commons day, Commons night and Stage; failing pairs frozen as waivers
